title: Ramda: rename converge to fanIn
prompt: This is a copy of Ramda 0.31.3 (the ES-module sources under source/, with its internal helpers). Rename the public function `R.converge` to `R.fanIn`: its module file, its export from the package entry, every other function that imports or calls it, and every comment, doc example and cross-reference that names it. The old name must not remain anywhere under source/. Behaviour, arity and currying must not change, and the functions built on top of it must keep working.
